market_universe.meaning: Stocks/options with a recent annual/lifetime high; recently and universe not numeric.

timeframe.meaning: Daily primary; weekly squeeze is optional context, not mandatory.

squeeze_formula.meaning: Squeeze Pro is named; paid formula is not disclosed on this page. Dirty Squeeze is not automatically the same version.

setup_definition.meaning: Daily price above EMA21; cup-and-handle; machine pattern/expiry not defined.

entry_order.meaning: After3 squeeze dots, prepare pullback/level-break entry; original8/21EMA or .618 level. Exact anchors/order mechanics need definition.

initial_stop.meaning: Underlying-price ATR disaster protection, not options premium stop; exact band/entry offset convention needs source reconciliation.

early_failure.meaning: Losing options trade after3 trading days exits/reassesses. Exact session count and options-vs-underlying net predicate not fully specified.

targets.meaning: Partial realization near prior highs; below-high offset, lot rounding and extension coordinates remain absent.
